associations.rationale: presentationEquiv is a particular algebra equivalence, not a statement that N-dimensional representations solve the displayed matrix relations.
hom_ext is a generic uniqueness lemma for homomorphisms from a presented algebra.
lift constructs a homomorphism when presentation relations vanish, a prerequisite for the matrix-relation interpretation.
toAlgHom turns a module structure into an endomorphism-valued homomorphism, but does not state the N-by-N relation-solving characterization.
The formal type is unavailable, so this matrix equivalence cannot directly establish the displayed claim.
